literal_en: If there be plenty of fruit on the ber trees, then there will be abundance of wheat.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses

meaning_pa: جس ورھے بیریاں نوں بیر رج کے لگن، اوس ورھے کنک دے وی ڈھیر لگدے نیں۔
